title: The website news caught up
summary:
The website news caught up with recent changes, and database indexes gave common lookups a shorter path.

The news page added December 8 entries about video and text models, search options, and Chart.js visualizations in Chat. These are updates to the highlights, not new launches in this day's PRs.

The same news update listed daily Pollen allowances for Spore, Seed, Flower, and Nectar, while keeping the December 3 Seedream 4.5 and Seedance Pro-Fast entry.

New indexes target auth and API-key lookups, event batch processing, and time-range queries. They are intended to reduce query time without changing API behavior.
